_meta.description: Validation-based deviations used by cp_engine/uncertainty.py (mean absolute deviations from published data; generated by tools/make_uncertainty_table.py from validation/results/summary.csv).

pure_default.row: default for a pure-component correlation with no validation row (assumed, not measured)

pressure_correction.row: case 1: Tait pressure correction, 5 liquids, 0.1-100 MPa

gas_residual_PR.row: case 6: 4 vapours, 0.5-10 MPa, ideal gas + Peng-Robinson residual

methanol+water.row: case 2: methanol + water: Cp, NRTL refitted to H^E

ethanol+toluene.row: case 2: ethanol + toluene: Cp, NRTL fitted to VLE + Cp^E (fit quality; held-out in case 2b)

glycerol+water.row: case 2: glycerol + water: Cp (x ≤ 0.08, 278-363 K), ideal fallback

nacl+water.row: case 2: NaCl + water (brine): Cp, apparent-molar-Cp model, INDEPENDENT point (doi:10.1016/j.jct.2016.09.031)

ethanol+water.row: case 2b: ethanol + water: mean Cp^E 298-323 K, source paper held out, NRTL refitted

ideal_fallback.row: case 2: ethanol + toluene: Cp, ideal mixture (for comparison)

suspension.row: case 3: all nanofluids: cp, Model II = Route A

bubble_point_K.row: case 6: ethanol + water: bubble temperature 13-101 kPa, NRTL VLE set + Peng-Robinson vapour (engine default)

freezing_point_K.row: case 2b: ice + water + ethanol: freezing points, 3-fold cross-validation (held-out), NRTL refitted (1 held-out point(s) with no predicted liquidus, excluded)
